title: World War III — The Room That Remains
prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create a landscape 3:2 cinematic graphic-novel illustration for a fictional World War III chapter of The House of Returning Authors. Serious, sad, intense, action-packed, emotionally humane. Painterly ink and textured CMYK printing, rich deep cyan shadows, restrained magenta, amber firelight, ivory highlights; sophisticated dramatic composition, no comedy. Entirely invented near-future setting, no real politicians, no identifiable current battle or national insignia. PG-13: no blood, gore, corpses, visible wounds, or graphic injury. No written words, speech balloons, captions, logos, or watermark. Scene 1, the warning: A theatre rehearsal abruptly becomes a wartime evacuation. A middle-aged man with dark curly hair in a charcoal coat and another middle-aged man with short graying hair in an olive coat hold open heavy theatre doors for frightened civilians. Outside, a vast near-future city is blacked out, distant orange explosions glow beyond the skyline, aircraft silhouettes streak through smoke, rain and flying paper swirl. A physical wheeled whiteboard still stands beside the abandoned stage, blank, two overturned empty armchairs behind it. Foreground a dropped theatrical mask beside a child's small backpack, with no child injured. Dynamic diagonal evacuation movement toward safety, urgent faces, enormous scale, mournful humanity.

One helps an older woman step across a gap while the other reaches back to support a frightened young adult.
